brief: Issue #46, brief of 2026-11-27, reworked 2026-11-28: the 22 approved concept sheets of docs/design/maps/*.md (PR #51) are the target. Each map below points at its sheet; the generator builds the field straight from the sheet grid (same sheet + same seed -> same field file). Categories: A river, B hills and slopes, C forest-heavy, D open steppe, V village (sheets 21-22, added by #51).

maps.name: Ruined bridge
maps.subtitle: A river cuts the field in two. The bridge is broken, so vehicles must queue at one ford far on the side.

maps.name: River bend
maps.subtitle: The river bends deep into the field. The attack runs along the west bank.

maps.name: Confluence
maps.subtitle: A tributary meets the main river in a Y. The attack splits into a west lane and an east lane.

maps.name: Overlook
maps.subtitle: One ford, and our hill stands right above it.

maps.name: Enemy heights
maps.subtitle: The enemy owns the hill on its own bank and sees our line.

maps.name: Left hill
maps.subtitle: A big hill covers the left flank. Whoever holds it sees half the map.

maps.name: Ridge
maps.subtitle: A ridge crosses the field. The attack must go through two saddles.

maps.name: Valley
maps.subtitle: Two hills with a valley between them. The attack goes through the valley.

maps.name: Long slope
maps.subtitle: The ground slopes down to our line. The enemy starts high and sees us.

maps.name: Gully mouth
maps.subtitle: A gully runs along the line of advance and ends in front of our hill.

maps.name: Clearings
maps.subtitle: A big forest with clearings. Sight is short.

maps.name: Forest road
maps.subtitle: One wide road runs through a dark forest. This is the map of ambushes: one lane by design.

maps.name: Forest and steppe
maps.subtitle: Forest on the left, open steppe on the right, a road and a farm between.

maps.name: Grove islands
maps.subtitle: Eleven groves of different size stand in the field like islands.

maps.name: Burned edge
maps.subtitle: In front of our forest edge is a burned strip that looks like trees but hides nothing and gives no cover.

maps.name: Open steppe
maps.subtitle: Almost no trees. Long sight lines; bushes, heaps, wrecks and craters only.

maps.name: Sunflower
maps.subtitle: A big sunflower field fills the middle of the map: it hides but gives no cover.

maps.name: Old trenches
maps.subtitle: Three old trench lines with wire cross the field.

maps.name: Wreck field
maps.subtitle: A destroyed column of vehicles lies in a diagonal line across the field.

maps.name: Farmstead
maps.subtitle: A farm with a silo, sheds and a combine stands north of a thin tree line.

maps.name: Village street
maps.subtitle: A long village street from the enemy edge to our line.

maps.name: Crossroads
maps.subtitle: Two village streets cross in the middle. Whoever holds the houses at the crossroads controls both routes.
